hero.subtitle: Carefully sourced, graded and exported from Ethiopia.

story.title: Start small. Earn trust. Grow.
story.body1: Birra Coffee General Trading PLC was established in 2010 by two young entrepreneurs with a vision to bring Ethiopia's finest products to global markets. Named after the Oromo word "Birra," meaning spring, the company represents renewal, prosperity, and abundance.
story.body2: Today, Birra is a diversified enterprise spanning coffee export, international trading, import services, coffee roasting, hospitality, and commercial real estate — driven by quality, integrity, and lasting partnerships.

origin.title: Seven origins, one birthplace of Arabica

regions.name: Yirgacheffe
regions.subtitle: SOUTHERN ETHIOPIA
regions.description: World-famous for its exquisite floral aroma, often jasmine, with bright citrusy or lemony acidity and a delicate, tea-like body. Primarily washed, Yirgacheffe is one of the most sought-after coffees in the world.

regions.name: Sidamo
regions.subtitle: SOUTHERN ETHIOPIA
regions.description: Features a vibrant, complex profile with fruity and floral notes, bright acidity, and a balanced, medium body. Sidama offers both washed and natural processed beans, each with distinct character.

regions.name: Guji
regions.subtitle: SOUTHERN OROMIA
regions.description: Gaining global acclaim for its complex fruitiness — berry, stone fruit — along with floral notes, winey acidity, and deep sweetness. Often naturally processed, showcasing intense, layered flavors.

regions.name: Harrar
regions.subtitle: EASTERN ETHIOPIA
regions.description: Renowned for its complex, winey or fruity notes, often with a distinct blueberry undertone and full body. All Harar is dry-processed (natural), with medium to light acidity and typical mocha flavor with aftertaste.

regions.name: Limmu
regions.subtitle: WESTERN ETHIOPIA
regions.description: Typically wet-processed (washed), offering a clean cup with pronounced floral and spicy notes, balanced acidity, and medium body. Limu's acidity is medium to pointed with a medium to full body and distinctive winy character.

regions.name: Jimma
regions.subtitle: SOUTHWESTERN ETHIOPIA
regions.description: Known for its balanced profile, often featuring floral notes, good acidity, and a medium body. The cup is attractive with medium acidity and a good, pleasant mouth feel.

regions.name: Lekempti
regions.subtitle: WESTERN ETHIOPIA
regions.description: Grayish in color with medium to pointed acidity and good mouth feel. Fruitiness is its unique character. Lekempti coffee from the Wollega zone is prized for its distinctive fruity profile.

journey.title: Eight stages between a cherry and your cup

stages.title: Farm
stages.desc: Grown by smallholder farms and cooperatives across seven Ethiopian regions.

stages.title: Harvest
stages.desc: Selective hand-picking, red cherry only, delivered to the nearest station the same afternoon.

stages.title: Processing
stages.desc: Depulped and fermented, or dried on raised beds — decided lot by lot against the buyer contract.

stages.title: Drying
stages.desc: Sun-dried on raised beds or patios, turned by hand and monitored until target moisture is reached.

stages.title: Milling & Hulling
stages.desc: Parchment and dried skin removed, beans cleaned and sized ahead of grading.

stages.title: Grading & Cupping
stages.desc: Sorted by screen size and density, then cupped by trained tasters to verify quality and grade.

stages.title: Export Preparation
stages.desc: Bagged, documented and compliance-checked, with full lot records prepared for shipment.

stages.title: Shipping
stages.desc: Containerized and shipped from the port of Djibouti to markets across the world.

Our coffee export arm, Birra Coffee General Trading PLC, has shipped premium Ethiopian Arabica since 2010 to markets across the Middle East, Europe, the Americas and Asia.

hero.title: From local trade to a global coffee house.
hero.body1: Birra's story begins far from any boardroom — in a small town near Galamso, in Ethiopia's West Hararghe zone. In 2010, two young entrepreneurs with over a decade of local trading experience took their first step in business by buying and selling cattle. That early trade taught them what still defines Birra today: reading a market, building trust with suppliers, and moving goods reliably from producer to buyer.
hero.body2: As their network and capital grew, they turned to the commodity closest to the region's identity and Ethiopia's global reputation — coffee — founding Birra Coffee General Trading PLC as a licensed exporter. Named for the Oromo word for spring, the season of harvest, Birra grew step by step into a diversified trading house: exporting premium Arabica to Europe, North America, the Middle East and Asia; importing construction materials, steel, vehicles and machinery; roasting and serving coffee through its own café; and developing commercial real estate including Birra Mall in Dire Dawa and Birra Tower and Birra Plaza in Addis Ababa. Today, with processing facilities in Dire Dawa and Addis Ababa, Birra remains rooted in the same instincts that built it: start small, earn trust, and grow with integrity.
